name: Kondaa
description: The undisputed star of Walibi Belgium and one of the most innovative and thrilling roller coasters in all of Europe. Kondaa is a magnificent Intamin Mega Coaster standing 50 metres tall and reaching 113 km/h, featuring the world's one and only non-inverting cobra roll — a completely unique element that has never been built on any other coaster on the planet. Kondaa delivers 15 extraordinary moments of airtime across its spectacular layout, with whippy transitions and forceful directional changes that make it a world-class experience. Opening in 2021 after a 100 million euro park investment, Kondaa has firmly established Walibi Belgium as a top-tier European destination for coaster enthusiasts. Minimum height: 130cm.

name: Pulsar
description: Winner of the Best New Attraction in the World award when it opened, Pulsar is a spectacular Mack Rides PowerSplash water coaster that sends riders up a 45-metre tower before dropping them at 100 km/h in a breathtaking plunge into a giant splash pool below. Pulsar was the fastest ride in the entire Benelux region when it opened and remains one of the most intense hybrid coaster-water ride experiences in Europe — combining genuine roller coaster forces with a drenching water spectacle. A true must-ride at Walibi Belgium. Minimum height: 120cm.

name: Loup-Garou
description: The legendary Werewolf — Walibi Belgium's iconic wooden roller coaster and one of the finest classic wooden coasters in the Benelux. Loup-Garou tears through its twisting wooden structure delivering the classic combination of thundering rumble, airtime and lateral forces that only a great wooden coaster can provide. With roomy, well-padded trains and a surprisingly comfortable ride, Loup-Garou is accessible and fun for families while still delivering genuine wooden coaster thrills. A beloved classic that has thrilled visitors since 1998. Minimum height: 120cm.

name: Dalton Terror
description: One of the tallest and most terrifying drop towers in all of Belgium — a 77-metre Intamin giant that slowly lifts riders to the top before releasing them in a stomach-dropping freefall at 106 km/h. Named after the villainous Dalton brothers from the Lucky Luke comic series, the Dalton Terror sits at the heart of Walibi's Western-themed area surrounded by a saloon and sheriff's office. The slow ascent builds unbearable anticipation before the sudden, brutal drop. When it opened in 1998 it was the tallest drop tower in Belgium and worldwide. Minimum height: 120cm.

name: Mecalodon
description: Brand new for 2025 as part of Walibi Belgium's spectacular 50th anniversary celebrations — Mecalodon is a triple-launch Gerstlauer family roller coaster and the longest family coaster in the entire Benelux at 925 metres. Set in the brand new Dock World themed area designed to resemble an industrial fishing port with cranes, containers and maritime details, Mecalodon combines three separate launches, decent airtime and tight turns into an action-packed ride accessible for the whole family. The most exciting new attraction at any Belgian park in years. Minimum height: 120cm.

name: Vampire
description: A classic suspended looping coaster (SLC) by Vekoma that has been thrilling Walibi Belgium visitors for decades — Vampire hangs riders beneath the track with their legs dangling free as the coaster tears through loops, corkscrews and inversions at high speed. Located near the park entrance, Vampire is often the first major thrill ride guests encounter and remains a popular rite of passage at Walibi Belgium. Minimum height: 140cm.

name: Buzzsaw
description: A thrilling Gerstlauer Euro-Fighter roller coaster featuring a beyond-vertical drop of more than 90 degrees that sends riders plummeting straight down and beyond in a disorienting and intense plunge. Buzzsaw is compact but ferocious, combining a steep lift hill, the terrifying beyond-vertical drop and multiple inversions in a short but very impactful package. One of the most intense experiences at Walibi Belgium for its size. Minimum height: 140cm.

name: Tiki Waka
description: A brilliant Gerstlauer Bobsled coaster that dips, dives and banks through its track over pathways and waterways in an exhilarating family ride that is as comfortable as it is thrilling. Tiki Waka is consistently praised as one of the best family coasters in Belgium — fast enough to excite older riders while remaining accessible for families with children. The tropical theming and waterway setting make it one of the most visually charming attractions in the park. Minimum height: 100cm with adult, 120cm alone.

name: Cobra
description: A classic stand-up roller coaster where riders experience the unique sensation of riding while standing upright — a format that creates very different forces and sensations compared to a seated coaster. Cobra is a long-standing Walibi Belgium icon located in the Karma World area and remains one of the few stand-up coasters still operating in Europe, making it a genuinely rare experience worth seeking out. Minimum height: 140cm.

name: Calamity Mine
description: A beloved classic mine train roller coaster that has been a staple of Walibi Belgium since 1992, winding through its Western-themed track with gentle dips and turns that make it perfect for families and younger riders seeking their first real coaster experience. Calamity Mine remains one of the most charming and endearing attractions at the park — a true family classic that multiple generations of Belgian visitors have grown up riding. Minimum height: 100cm.

name: Radja River
description: A classic river rapids ride delivering exciting twists, turns and guaranteed soakings as circular rafts carry groups of riders through churning white water channels, waterfalls and dramatic splashes. Radja River is one of Walibi Belgium's essential summer attractions and a firm family favourite — the unpredictability of how wet you get makes every ride different and keeps the laughter going throughout. Minimum height: 100cm.

name: Flash Back
description: A thrilling water ride featuring three dramatic drops — including one in reverse — and a spectacular final splash that guarantees riders a thorough soaking. Flash Back was rethemed in 2025 as part of the new Dock World area and now sits within the park's exciting maritime industrial landscape. The reverse drop element makes Flash Back stand out from typical log flume rides and creates moments of genuine surprise and disorientation. Minimum height: 110cm.

name: Challenge of Tutankhamun
description: An immersive dark ride journey into the ancient tomb of Tutankhamun — a classic Walibi Belgium attraction that takes riders through elaborately themed Egyptian chambers filled with hieroglyphs, mummies and unexpected surprises. Challenge of Tutankhamun combines gentle dark ride storytelling with sudden scares and effects, making it ideal for families with children who want something atmospheric rather than purely thrill-focused. Minimum height: 100cm.

name: Palais du Genie
description: An immersive 4D experience — the Palace of the Genie — where the spirits Zanzar and Babas lead visitors through a world of magic, illusions and spectacular effects that challenge perception and create memorable shared experiences. Palais du Genie is one of Walibi Belgium's most unique and family-friendly attractions, combining theatrical storytelling with surprising visual effects in a beautifully themed palace setting. Suitable for all ages.
